Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 12 s. 2022 Feb 21, 2022 DIR. MARIA LOURDES L. AGUSTIN Regional Director, DILG-NCR 4th Floor, Annex Building-SRA Sugar Center Compound, North Ave. Diliman, Quezon City Dear RD Agustin: This pertains to your Memorandum dated 24 January 2022 forwarding to the Central Office the letter dated 20 January 2022 of Engr. Mario D. Cruz, Jr., Acting Punong Barangay (PB) of Barangay Carmona, Makati City, requesting from the Department an authority to appoint vacant positions in Barangay Carmona, Makati City. Per your Memorandum, various appointive positions in Barangay Carmona, Makati City were vacated due to resignation. Hence, Acting PB Cruz, Jr. is requesting for an authority to authorize him to make appointments for the vacant positions in the barangay citing as reference Section 46 of the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC) in relation to DILG Memorandum Circular (MC) No. 2019-21, re: "OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES AND RULES IN IMPLEMENTING ADMINISTRATIVE ORDER NO. 15 SERIES OF 2018". Per City Resolution No. 2021-0481 passed by the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Makati, a 12-month suspension is thereby imposed against elected PB Joselito M. Salvador and seven (7) other Sangguniang Barangay Members. Thereafter, acting PB Cruz and several other Acting Sangguniang Barangay Members were designated by the DILG Secretary. Hence, the request of Acting PB Cruz, Jr. for an authority to appoint the following vacant positions in Barangay Carmona: (1) 1 Bantay Bayan; (2) 1 Rescue; (3) 2 Administrative Aide 1; (4) 2 Administrative Aide Ill; (5) 1 Administrative Aide IV; (6) 1 Administrative Aide V; and (7) 5 Tagalinis. I Entitled, "A RESOLUTION ADOPTING THE RECOMMENDATION OF THE COMMITTEE ON LAWS, RULES AND ETHICS IN ADMINISTRATIVE CASE NO. 2021-002, ENTITLED AS, "RENE-IL DE GUZMAN VS. PUNONG BARANGAY JOSELITO M. SALVADOR AND BARANGAY KAGAWADS JASON S. LAYUG, ANDRES F. CHUA, JEFFREY L. SORDAN, CHRISTOPHER B. GUERRA, ROSALIE DL. GARCIA, MARIA ANDREA PAULA S. VICENTE AND VIRGILIO S. GUILLERMO OF BARANGAY CARMONS", WHICH IS TO IMPOSE THE PENALTY OF SUSPENSION FOR A PERIOD OF TWELVE (12) MONTHS AGAINST ALL RESPONDENTS, SUBJECT TO EXISTING LAWS, RULES AND REGULATIONS." "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

The Departrnent has been of the view that if it is apparent that the incapacity, as in the case of legal incapacity due to suspension from ofice, exceeds thirty (30) working days, the poær to appoint, suspend or dismiss may already be exercised by the acting local chief executive immediately upon his or her assumption to that offce in an acting capacity. Nowhere in the language of said provision can it be found that such power to appoint, suspend or dismiss empbyees, can only be exercised aner the lapse of thirty working days even if the period of temporary incapacity is determined to exceed 30 working days. Per City Resolution No. 2021-u8, PB Salvador and 7 other Sangguniang Barangay Members were suspended from offce for a period of 12 months. Applying the foregoing in the case at hand, since tie period of temporary incapacity exceeds 30 working days, we are of the view that Acting PB Cruz may already exercise the power to appoint, suspend or dismiss employees This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts.
